description: Change of use of basement and ground floor levels from Spa (Sui Generis) to a Retail and/or Restaurant use with external refurbishment of the shopfront.
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (Drawings 561-PP-01(A), 02(B), 03(A) and 04(B), Planning Statement and Appendices 1 and 2 (Photos and Flood Risk Information) [received 17/08/2020]) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - The premises shall be restricted to retail and/or restaurant uses only within Class E of The Town and Country Planning (Use Classes) (Amendment) (England) Regulations 2020), and shall be used for no other purposes.
Condition : 4 - The use hereby permitted for Class E retail and/or restaurant purposes shall not be carried on outside the following times 07:00 - 23:00.

Condition : 5 - Prior to first occupation of the unit, a Delivery and Servicing Plan shall be submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority. This shall include a restriction that the size of delivery vehicles be no greater than 7.5T and that all servicing must be undertaken from the loading bay west of the site to prevent obstruction of the bus stop adjacent to the proposed development. The Delivery and Servicing Plan shall be implemented in accordance with the approved details for the lifetime of the development.

Condition : 6 - Any kitchen noise and odour extraction/exhaust system installed would require a full planning permission and must be in compliance with the DEFRA guidance for the control of odour and noise from commercial kitchen exhaust systems and flue stacks set no less than one metre above the fa?ade height of the building shall be installed.
